status: Root-reviewed saved-only source and23synthetics; no firstguard identity assumption transferred. New exactfreeze required before numeric read.
execution_gate: Exact new protocol/source/test/parent source freeze before saved numeric analysis; complete unmodified producer/source/input checks. No output overwrite.

objects.path_comparisons: outer_selected and full_selected separately, each against same_target_B, same_target_annual and exact_thirds_annual; retain all-original reference summaries and exact same-invested-ID summaries.
objects.pair_definition: Policy minus reference on identical original IDs, means/ordinary medians and fixed1e-12 positive/negative/numerical-tie counts; four event-ID partitions plus rejected original IDs.
objects.group_tails: For actual matched model/reference cohorts retain median and inverse-CDF P10 CAGR, median/inverse-CDF P90 MDD and fractional worst10% CVaR90. These are group quantiles, distinct from per-ID difference summaries.
objects.coverage: Original_n, financial_n, initial noninvested, Q1 Review/non-Balanced/initialExecutionReview, funded support referrals and mean automated-period fraction stay separate. Fixed-family V3-minus-V2b signed automatic_fraction/support_review changes are measured. InitialReview financials are NULL.
objects.full_refit: Full-selected results are fitting/resubstitution descriptions only. Full results are not mixed into primary OOF prediction diagnostics or the outer comparison.

pure_saved_market_reconstruction.source: The five outer exact-thirds annual reference groups cover IDs1-120 once and have positive three-asset posttrade holdings.
pure_saved_market_reconstruction.identity: Nominal gross=next holdings/posttrade holdings; inflation gross=next CPI/current CPI; realgross=nominalgross/inflationgross. This is saved physical-account inversion, not a raw-file parser or new market simulation.
pure_saved_market_reconstruction.guards: Reject zero/nonpositive postholdings, wrong shapes, nonpositive/invalid CPI/gross, duplicate/missing/out-of-development IDs. For funded selected arms independently check reconstructed markets against saved training_real_gross and realized_real_gross.
pure_saved_market_reconstruction.forecasting_scope: For each outer job use only its declared training IDs for current-calendar training returns/scales and previous-calendar conditioning. Actual current return is the scored outcome and never enters the prediction. Reconstructing an offline table does not grant future data to the policy.

market_prediction_comparison.unit: Exactly one originalID/calendar-year row, independent of which candidate policies were funded. All120outerIDs remain even when the selected service refuses investment.
market_prediction_comparison.forecasts: At t0 uniform only. At positive periods compare uniform mean and50%uniform/50%Gaussian-conditional mean on exactly the same observations. Conditioning features are previous3realreturns plus inflation; population scale floor1e-8 uses training only.
market_prediction_comparison.loss: For each actual vector average the3 asset squared errors standardized by current-calendar training population standard deviations floored1e-8. Also retain unstandardized mean squared error. The standardization distribution is training-only.
market_prediction_comparison.aggregation: Report inception and positive periods separately. Average each scenario annual loss first, then scenarios equally. No annual-row or ensemble-member independence claim, no candidate-family duplication.
market_prediction_comparison.not_a_full_policy_result: Asset prediction MSE measures one-step mean forecast quality, not large-loss protection, recursive feasibility, a true conditional law or expected terminal strategy performance.

policy_prediction_comparison.unit: Only outer-selected funded gate_evaluated periods. Pending has no fresh prediction. Original actual branch logic retained: primary13 vs executed mitigation9; mitigation pairedscore is an annotation, not its maxmin ranking objective.
policy_prediction_comparison.forecasts: Read actual_decision_source: primary uses original selected13/index0hold; mitigation uses separate mitigation_selected_index and9point member arrays. Primaryindex−1 and support_feasibleFalse remain. Separate mitigation_trade/mitigation_hold phases. All actual annotations scored on actual action; pairedscore does not rank fallback.
policy_prediction_comparison.realized_growth: log(actual next real wealth / pretrade real wealth), including selected current fee once.
policy_prediction_comparison.realized_benefit: log(actual next real wealth / same-market one-step hold real wealth), using pretrade holdings and saved actual joint real gross. This is a one-step physical-action contrast, not an alternative complete-policy rollout.
policy_prediction_comparison.metrics: Scenario-equal growth and benefit bias/RMSE; Brier for empirical predicted next-L-event mass; joint fraction predicted positive benefit with realized nonpositive benefit; directional support misses and supported-safe budget-floor failures.
policy_prediction_comparison.decision_score: Separately deduplicate by job/ID/year and compare the actual saved uniform or min-member paired objective score to realized paired benefit. This avoids treating five members as five decisions.
policy_prediction_comparison.support_diagnostics: Actual nextwealth below the action minimum supported nextwealth; separately a supported-safe action failing its declared budgetfloor. Use relative realwealth1e-12 tolerance. Do not define finite continuous support coverage by exact tuple equality.
policy_prediction_comparison.reliability_bins: Fixed[0,1/3),[1/3,2/3),[2/3,1] predicted next-event mass bins per forecast/phase, emptybins NULL, with both annual rows and distinct scenarios. This is descriptive, not proof of conditional calibration.
policy_prediction_comparison.quantities_not_available: Expected next-MDD was not in the declared engine trace, so no after-result substitute estimator is added. Full-path risk remains evaluated in the main cohorts.
policy_prediction_comparison.cushion_diagnostic: Save current active m with each policy/forecast row; deduplicated decision summaries report scenario-equal mean and observed min/max m. m is a deterministic proposal-state scale, not predicted event probability, confidence, inferred risk preference or a hard exposure cap. No new estimator or calibration target is introduced.

failure_handling: No output overwrite. In-process numerical/identity failures preserve failed manifest and traceback; producer bytes/source/protocol are checked for changes. No automatic repair, data substitution or policy reselection.
interpretation: Descriptive development OOF evidence of a frozen exploratory learner. Historical development/final exposure remains disclosed; unchanged old artifacts are not overwritten and this does not revalidate them.
freeze_note: Do not bind this draft protocol SHA as a mutable current-file source map in a prefreeze review; source and test hashes can be bound, and root will separately stamp the final protocol then execution receipt.
parent_intervention: All same context/candidate/job/originalID complete-H inner paths compare the V3 scaled primary proposal architecture with V2b. Initial financial identity must match. Exact metadata and funded inception posttrade/fees/moved/trades plus year0/year1 holdings/CPI/realwealth/historicalpeak/runningMDD are checked. There is no firstguard-prefix or same-referral assertion: guard timing, actual later actions and autonomous continuity can change. Retain all36 context×6tuple groups including all-NULL groups; per context each validation market appears once. Do not pool context/family repeats as independent samples or claim population causality.
selected_parent_contrast: Outer/full separate; all four financial funding partitions retained. Both-funded summaries are descriptive selected-policy comparisons because selected tuples may differ; no imputation for old Review and no isolated cushion-effect claim at selected-learner level.
initial_identity: All144 inner physical metadata groups and NULL/funded identity match; exact dtype/shape/value initial first-year slices, not approximate allclose. Later arrays are deliberately unconstrained. Failure is retained, never repaired by excluding a path.

synthetic_validation.checks: All-NULL36groups, changed guard timing/automatic fraction allowed, support referral difference, exact initial-year identity and tiny fee difference rejection, first-year change rejection/later divergence accepted, branch-specific forecast arrays, deterministic m separate from probability, past-only OOF asset mean MSE, original3refs and NULL, empty bins and calendar units, dev/freeze gates.
